brief.title: Ice and Coin
brief.premise: A guild factotum on a nomad market built into a captured comet must arbitrate the theft of a sealed star-map before the comet's perihelion burn scatters the fleet.
constraints: Ships manoeuvre on sails, tethers and reaction plumes; no energy weapons.

world.name: The Comet Market
world.description: A captured comet hollowed into a rotating bazaar that rides its own orbit, where guilds, pilots and ice-miners trade under burn articles until perihelion scatters them.

locations.name: The Core Vaults
locations.description: Hollowed ice halls near the comet's heart where the ice barons keep their claims.

locations.name: The Tether Docks
locations.description: The sprawl of tethers where ships berth against the comet's slow spin.

locations.name: The Map House
locations.description: The guild house where star-maps are drawn, sealed and registered.

locations.name: The Cinder Gardens
locations.description: Sunward glasshouses in the slag skin where growers farm the perihelion light.

locations.name: The Long Hall
locations.description: The arbitration hall where claims are heard under the burn articles.

factions.name: The Mapmakers' Guild
factions.description: The guild that draws, seals and arbitrates every registered star-map.

factions.name: The Ice Barons
factions.description: Claim-holders who mine the core and buy up tethers before each burn.

factions.name: The Free Pilots' Compact
factions.description: Independent pilots who fly the routes the guilds only chart.

rules.statement: At perihelion every claim is settled or forfeited; nothing litigates through the burn.
A sealed star-map may be opened only by its sealer or by the arbiter of the Long Hall.
Weapons aboard are blades, tools and harpoons; powered arms breach the market's charter.
Every ship pays an ice-tithe for its berth; unpaid tithes cost tether rights.

history.name: The Capture
history.description: Free pilots netted the comet, hollowed its core and founded a market no planet could tax.

history.name: The Map Wars
history.description: Rival charts nearly wrecked the fleet at a perihelion; the guild won the right to seal every route.

history.name: The Pilots' Compact
history.description: The free pilots won arbitration rights in the Long Hall after refusing to fly sealed routes.

conflicts.name: The Stolen Chart
conflicts.description: A sealed map of the perihelion route was stolen and resold; the guild calls it piracy, the pilot who holds it calls it salvage.

conflicts.name: The Tether Grab
conflicts.description: The ice barons are buying up tethers before the burn, stranding pilots who owe ice-tithes.

characters.name: Sable Onuoha
characters.description: A factotum of the Mapmakers' Guild apprenticed to the Long Hall's arbiter, who reads broken seals the way pilots read weather.
characters.motivation: To see the map settled by charter and not by whoever holds it last.
characters.goal: Arbitrate the stolen chart before the perihelion burn forfeits every claim.
characters.flaw: She believes procedure protects her from choosing sides.
characters.internal_conflict: The charter she serves may be wrong about who the map belongs to.
characters.external_conflict: Every claimant wants the arbitration to outlast the burn.

abilities.name: Seal-reading
abilities.description: Reads a broken guild seal to tell when and by whom it was opened.

characters.arc: Sable learns to judge the charter by what it costs, not what it says.

characters.name: Rho Vass
characters.description: A free pilot of the compact who bought the stolen map believing it was salvage and now holds the only copy of the burn route.
characters.motivation: To keep the route for the compact, which the guilds priced out of its own skies.
characters.goal: Hold the map until arbitration concedes the compact's claim.
characters.flaw: He cannot admit the fence was wrong because the cause feels right.
characters.internal_conflict: He stole nothing, yet everything he built rests on a theft.
characters.external_conflict: Sable's seal-reading can prove the map was opened before he bought it.

abilities.name: Perihelion piloting
abilities.description: Flies a sail rig through a burn approach better than any guild pilot.

characters.arc: Rho trades the stolen map for a route the compact can win honestly.

characters.name: Kest Inger
characters.description: An ice baron factor who bought the stolen map to convert it into tether rights and quietly started the Tether Grab.
characters.motivation: To turn the map into tethers before the burn makes every claim void.
characters.goal: Convert the chart into berth options he can sell at perihelion prices.
characters.flaw: He treats every debt as an asset until it is collected from him.
characters.internal_conflict: His father's ship was wrecked in the Map Wars; he swore never to starve on principle.
characters.external_conflict: If the theft is arbitrated, his purchases unwind with the claim.

abilities.name: Claim-stacking
abilities.description: Bundles claims, tithes and options so debtors owe him before they know it.

characters.arc: Kest's stacked claims collapse at perihelion and he must pick which debts to keep.

relationships.description: Sable arbitrates Rho's salvage claim on the stolen map.
relationships.conflict: Her charter calls it piracy; his compact calls it salvage.

relationships.description: Kest's purchases unwind if Sable rules the map stolen.
relationships.conflict: He buys influence over the arbitration she must keep honest.

evidence_summary: The world, cast and storyboard satisfy the brief's nomad comet-market setting; deterministic validators are clean and there are no blocking defects.
